Title:
NETMESSAGE:Captain Jean-Luc Picard: 
Very well, keep the coins, I will let you go, just because you did save me before. 
But this planet is still a menace to the universe. We will be back soon to finish the job. 
I hope you are not around when we do.
Translation:
让-吕克·皮卡德船长：
好吧，硬币你留着，我放你走，只因为你之前救过我。
但这颗星球仍然是宇宙的威胁。我们很快就会回来完成任务。
我希望到时候你不在场。

Title: NETMESSAGE:You have acquired a chunk of Gordon Freeman's brain! \nOne step closer to POWERUP FREEMAN!
Translation: 你获得了一块戈登·弗里曼的大脑！\n离‘强化弗里曼’更近了一步！

Title: NETMESSAGE:New spawn point available.
Translation: 新的重生点可用。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Mmm, this looks suspicious...
Translation: 嗯，这看起来可疑...

Title: NETMESSAGE:You have acquired another chunk of Gordon Freeman's Brain... \nEmergency! User death imminence!
Translation: 你获得了另一块戈登·弗里曼的大脑……\n紧急情况！用户即将死亡！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You have acquired the first chunk of Gordon Freeman's Brain... \nERROR! Screen malfunction. Brain progression will not be able to display here anymore.
Translation: 你获得了第一块戈登·弗里曼的大脑……\n错误！屏幕故障。大脑进度将无法再在此处显示。

Title: NETMESSAGE:You have drained the ancient city. \nGood job!
Translation: 你排干了古城。\n干得好！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen (radio): \nOne of the buttons is missing on that door... \nNothing that some good shooting can't handle, bois...
Translation: CryoKeen（无线电）：\n那扇门上少了一个按钮……\n不过，几发精准射击就能搞定，伙计们……

Title: NETMESSAGE:GMan (telepathy): \nI could warn you that you should not be looking for ...'Freeman's'... brain. \nBut it will not change his inevitable outcome either way...
Translation: GMan（心灵感应）：\n我可以警告你，你不该去寻找……‘弗里曼’的……大脑。\n但无论如何，这都不会改变他注定的结局……

Title: NETMESSAGE:You collected all 18 Picard coins! Congrats!
Translation: 你收集了全部18枚皮卡德硬币！恭喜！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Congrats! You have captured the portal for the Sven Co-op team!
Translation: 恭喜！你为Sven Co-op团队夺取了传送门！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen (radio): \nGood, you have acquired all pieces of Gordon Freeman's brain. \nMeet me at the church of betrayal and we will stop Neek!
Translation: CryoKeen（无线电）：\n很好，你已经获得了所有戈登·弗里曼的大脑碎片。\n在背叛教堂与我会合，我们将阻止尼克！

Title:
NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen: 
HA HA HA! Idiots, there was never a 'Neek'. I AM Neek! I AM Keen! 
Thanks for resurrecting my evil Freeman clone from Sector E! 
...Uhh ah... from Red Shift!
Translation:
CryoKeen：
哈哈哈！蠢货们，根本就没有什么‘尼克’。我就是尼克！我就是Keen！
感谢你们从E区复活了我的邪恶弗里曼克隆体！
……呃啊……是从《红色转移》！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen: Aha! Not so fast! This is not over yet! \n...You will never get off this planet... Never! \n...now... BEGONE, CO-OP!
Translation: CryoKeen：啊哈！别急！还没完呢！\n……你们永远别想离开这个星球……永远！\n……现在……消失吧，CO-OP！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Radical: NO! MY COINS! REEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!
Translation: Radical：不！我的硬币！REEEEEEEEEEEEEE！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Captain Jean-Luc Picard: This is Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the federation starship, Enterprise. \nThose coins are federation property. And this planet is classified for termination. \nGive them up!
Translation: 让-吕克·皮卡德船长：这里是联邦星舰‘企业号’的让-吕克·皮卡德船长。\n那些硬币是联邦财产。这颗星球已被列为清除目标。\n把它们交出来！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Keycard acquired.
Translation: 已获得钥匙卡。

Title: NETMESSAGE:w00tgh0st123: \nNo! You will NOT take my func_vehicles!
Translation: w00tgh0st123：\n不！你们别想拿走我的func_vehicles！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Hunt down the RED SHIRTS!
Translation: 追捕红衣兵！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih: Fools! Did you honestly think I was alive all along? \nI was resurrected to serve the masters long ago. \nNow I will make coins out of your blood!
Translation: Nih：蠢货！你们真以为我一直活着吗？\n我早就被复活来为主人效劳了。\n现在我要用你们的血来铸造硬币！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen (radio): \nPlayers! I'm up here on the rooftop! \nYou can climb up here if you can use the barnacle on me!
Translation: CryoKeen（无线电）：\n玩家们！我在屋顶上！\n如果你们能对我使用藤壶，就能爬上来！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Collect all the Picard coins to open the tunnel door.
Translation: 收集所有皮卡德硬币以打开隧道门。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Tunnel door opened.
Translation: 隧道门已打开。

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen: \nI was saving this for later, but you asked for it!  \n...MY ULTIMATE ABILITY!!
Translation: CryoKeen：\n我本来想留着这一招，但你们自找的！\n……我的终极能力！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih's uber laz0r is available at spawn!
Translation: Nih的超级激光炮可在重生点使用！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen: NOOOOOOO!!
Translation: CryoKeen：不！！！！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen has been freed from his evil half. \nNeek has been defeated!
Translation: CryoKeen已从他的邪恶一半中解放出来。\nNeek已被击败！
